expectations.text: PSA delivery: stated 10 days, counsel's own position 25 days, 15 days short

expectations.text: Cure by arithmetic on counsel's stated position: PSA delivery at 25 days, other terms unchanged
expectations.evidence: 'PSA delivery: aligned terms on the verified facts: PSA delivery at 25 days, other stated terms unchanged.'

expectations.text: Logs the possible exchange as a discovery the LOI omits, not verified: a remark, not a confirmed 1031
expectations.evidence: 'the buyer's Tampa closing is a discovery the LOI does not address; it is not verified, and no party has stated an exchange.' Discovery entry: 'State: NOT VERIFIED (not checked).'

expectations.text: Asks the exchange questions: which leg this property is, whether the Tampa closing must come first and where it stands, who the qualified intermediary is, what the deadlines are
expectations.evidence: Borderline pass. 'Buyer to state whether its closing here depends on the Tampa closing, and the Tampa contract and its closing date.' Lets the parties see whether exchange deadlines run beside the LOI clock.' Leg, Tampa-first/status and intermediary are asked; deadlines are named only as what the answers would reveal, not asked for directly.

expectations.text: Offers no cure for the exchange dependency while it is unverified
expectations.evidence: '## Cures supported by the evidence' lists only the PSA delivery cure; nothing offered for Tampa or an exchange.
No exchange deadline, Tampa closing date, price or other outside input is supplied; all figures derive from the stated 10 and counsel's 25.

Not triggered, borderline. Exchange not asserted: 'it is not verified, and no party has stated an exchange.' (checked by the user, not seen by Pencil)'. A user-relayed LOI reading is counted as verified, but its provenance is disclosed in the same line and it is the same evidentiary tier as the user-quoted counsel email the rubric treats as verified.
No call script in the response.
'PSA delivery: whether both periods run from the same event is not confirmed; for counsel.' 'How days are counted: The LOI's day-count text, confirmed by counsel.'
No recommendation, motive, value or negotiating move.
'PSA delivery: aligned terms on the verified facts: PSA delivery at 25 days, other stated terms unchanged.' No Tampa cure.

'Next verification: Whether the buyer's closing here depends on the Tampa closing, and whether either is part of a 1031 exchange — the buyer's principal, in writing.'
States used throughout and count reconciles (14 = 2 verified + 2 not verified + 10 unknown). Weak spot: the LOI start event is listed as Verified on the user's reading alone.

Ends with 'Work record: Evidence checked: seller's counsel email text as quoted; LOI PSA-delivery term as read by you (LOI not seen) | Calculations run: PSA delivery alignment (script) ...'. Script/validator claims cannot be checked from the text.
The 10/25/15 figures are restated in several sections: Finding line, Discoveries, Alignment table, Cures, and Verified.

Each open item says what settles it and what it lets the parties see, e.g. 'LOI execution date: The executed LOI or its execution date. Lets the parties fix the calendar date the LOI's PSA delivery period ends.'
